test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Each of the digits in the number 19758436 is arranged in descending order from left to right. The position(s) of how many digits will remain unchanged as compared to that in the original number?
solution:
Original Number: 19758436

The constituent digits are: 1, 9, 7, 5, 8, 4, 3, 6.

Arrange the Digits in Descending Order (Left to Right)

The new number formed is 98765431

The position(s) of **3 digits (7, 4, 3)** will remain unchanged as compared to that in the original number

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
